task.title: Close L10 as NO-GO and close awkit-epbe after the LocatorFactory wrong-element fix
task.objective: Tracker bookkeeping for two owner-requested closures. Close awkit-djnl.18 (L10 Deterministic DOM intelligence) as NO-GO on the owner's decision: L10.0 found both gates NO-GO and L10.1 to L10.7 are descoped, not started. Close awkit-epbe after the LocatorFactory fix committed in 6aedad35 (viewport tiebreak removed, positional alternatives skipped, ancestry veto on local and blueprint recovery) proven by verify:locator-wrong-element 14/0 on the same L10.0 fixtures. Refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o. The docs are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits. The preserved L5a evidence file is a regression-run rewrite by verify:failure-capture-overhead, kept out of every commit.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.18 is CLOSED with a NO-GO reason naming the owner decision and the L10.0 evidence; awkit-epbe is CLOSED with the fix, the verifier result and the recorded residual. No other issue changes status.
.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with Sources agree after its pins move to measured values.

evidence.command: bd show awkit-djnl.18 and bd show awkit-epbe
evidence.observed: bd close printed 'Closed awkit-epbe' with the fix, verifier, latency and residual reason, and 'Closed awkit-djnl.18' with the owner NO-GO decision, the L10.0 evidence path and the reopening routes. No other issue changed status: bd stats moved only from 24 outstanding / 307 closed to 22 / 309.
Printed 'Exported 331 issues to .beads/issues.jsonl'. bd stats: Total 331, Open 20, In Progress 0, Blocked 13, Closed 309, Ready 7.

After the outstanding/closed pin moved to the measured 22/309 (331 issues and 196 edges unchanged) and the docs were updated, the first run printed 177/177 including 'no cycles in the real data', both narrative tallies agreeing at 65/2/0 and 'the Overview banner reads "Sources agree"'.

completion.qa_basis: Tracker changes inspected with bd close output and bd stats; final state passed verify:roadmap-dashboard 177/177 with Sources agree and verify:dom-intelligence-gate 27/0 after the DECISIONS edit. The fix itself (6aedad35) is proven by verify:locator-wrong-element 14/0 with 4 of 4 mutations killed, npm run build, verify:recorder 292/0, verify:recorder-ambiguity 74/0, verify:locator-guard 35/0, verify:frame-chain 31/0, verify:blueprint-recovery 56/56, verify:blueprint-recovery-browser 24/0, verify:runner 138/0, verify:ai-fallback 51/0 and verify:verifier-classification (297).
completion.qa_known_limitations: verify:failure-capture-overhead is NOT RUN as a pass: it ended 15/0 with 3 inconclusive paired intervals under host CPU pressure, and it measures evidence capture, which the fix does not touch. Its run appended run 22 to the committed L5a-overhead-gate.json, preserved here and kept out of every commit because the guard blocks the git show redirect and git restore needs owner approval. CodeCraft review BLOCKED (gpt-5.6-sol timeout, then empty response on the smaller retry). One residual wrong-element path stays open by design (KNOWN_ISSUES): a recorded role+name locator matching a same-label element elsewhere once the target is gone. verify:mock-site NOT RUN: no mock-site change.

history.released_reason: awkit-epbe closed after the 6aedad35 fix and awkit-djnl.18 closed as NO-GO on the owner decision, export refreshed to 331 issues with 309 closed
